locAddress: 23 Beves Ave, Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, 0045

reviews.text: Hands down the most authentic Neapolitan crust in Pretoria. The Leopard spots on the crust and quality ingredients speak for themselves!
reviews.author: — Marco S. (Pretoria East)

reviews.text: That Bacon & Jalapeño smash burger is next level. Crisp edges, insanely juicy patties, and secret sauce that hits the spot every time.
reviews.author: — Willem K. (Centurion)

reviews.text: Booked Die Meelhuis for our private birthday event. Our guests are still talking about the woodfired pizzas three weeks later!
reviews.author: — Annelize M. (Event Catering)
